name: Winter's Presents
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I hear Greatfather Winter - with the generous support of Smokywood Pastures - has put presents for everyone under the tree in Ironforge. I wish I could go, but I've got to look after the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt.

But you should definitely check it out. I'm sure Greatfather Winter has some presents with your name on them.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Greatfather Winter. He is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Oh, ho hello there! You can only be here for one reason: to open your Winter Veil presents.

Now, don't you worry, Greatfather Winter hasn't forgotten about his favorite friend Champion. Look under the tree and you'll find your gifts.

During this season of giving, perhaps your friends would also enjoy receiving some of Smokeywood Pasture's excellent products?
